ng-add.description: ESLint-first CLI, ESLint config, and optional omega-setup ecosystem.

ecosystem.description: Creates .../app/omega-setup.ts and merges omegaSetupProviders into app.config.ts (global Omega bootstrap).

feature.description: Adds an Omega feature folder (models, services, omega/, page) and merges flow + agent into omega-setup.ts.

remove.description: Reverts eslint-then in angular.json, trims eslint.config.mjs, removes omegaSetupProviders from app.config. Optional: delete app/omega-setup.ts. Then npm uninstall omega-angular.
